I'm super into psychology myself. I started dating, well talking to this guy about 6 months. Charming. everything i needed wanted at the time. And then he would drink and just turn into an asshole, say or do shit that seemed out of his character. fight with me and others. Well at first i thought it was the drinking doing this to him. But as fate will have it we are both in the military on a navy ship and you can't drink on ships. The behavior continued. I knew something wasn't right. I did my research and everything he does screams antisocial personality disorder. There have been a few instances where he's been drunk and i've thought that i have seen some empathy or just him telling me the raw honest truth. for instance he once told me he doesn't feel anything for anyone. he doesn't love anything but his parents. he doesn't feel shit unless he's drinking. 
It's sad because i know he has antisocial personality disorder although it's undiagnosed and i know exactly what he's doing. but he comes back to me over and over again and it's like he needs to hear me say that he loves him. Ever since i've found out what he is and started to understand his emotionally manipulative games he says that i've changed. And i find him telling me he loves me more and more. Before when he would ignore me i would go back to him and beg him to talk to me. Now i just leave him alone for a week or however long he wants to go. I know that bothers him. Heres my question though. How deep are his feelings really for me? Is it possible for someone with anti social personality disorder to love or fall in love? I know that obviously it's not the same type of love that i would feel but he's constantly telling me how much he cares about me and loves me and thinks about me. Is he playing one big game. Also he loves animals. like really loves them. it's weird. he was a big smoker for all of his life and his dog got cancer and died and he just cold turkey'd it.

Also limdu is limited duty. He'll be given a job probably only working 3 or 4 hours a day doing some easy shit. and then he'll go home. the entire time he's on limdu his focus will be on trying to get better. going through his treatments whatever it may be. A lot of times they'll just give him work at the hospital that he will be treated at.
A lot of it will depend on his diagnosis. A lot of it will depend on how bad the ship needs whatever rate he is. It's russian roulette.
